title: Errors when building godot with `disable_3d=yes`
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in current master https://github.com/godotengine/godot/commit/b377562b52fa8a68a99d5e818d8e08ac8d3fd7da
- Not reproducible in 4.4.stable

### System information

Windows 11

### Issue description

I’m getting some errors when building with the following command: scons platform=android target=template_debug arch=arm64 disable_3d=yes

```command
ERROR: scene\debugger\scene_debugger.cpp:1644:43: error: use of undeclared identifier 'selected_3d_nodes'; did you mean 'selected_ci_nodes'?
                                if (!selected_ci_nodes.is_empty() || !selected_3d_nodes.is_empty()) {
                                                                      ^~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
                                                                      selected_ci_nodes
scene\debugger/scene_debugger.h:242:24: note: 'selected_ci_nodes' declared here
        LocalVector<ObjectID> selected_ci_nodes;
                              ^
scene\debugger\scene_debugger.cpp:1713:64: error: use of undeclared identifier 'selected_3d_nodes'; did you mean 'selected_ci_nodes'?
        const int limit = max_selection - (selected_ci_nodes.size() + selected_3d_nodes.size());
                                                                      ^~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
                                                                      selected_ci_nodes
scene\debugger/scene_debugger.h:242:24: note: 'selected_ci_nodes' declared here
        LocalVector<ObjectID> selected_ci_nodes;
                              ^
scene\debugger\scene_debugger.cpp:1851:65: error: use of undeclared identifier 'nodes_3d'; did you mean 'nodes_ci'?
        if (!changed && nodes_ci.size() == selected_ci_nodes.size() && nodes_3d.size() == selected_3d_nodes.size()) {
                                                                       ^~~~~~~~
                                                                       nodes_ci
scene\debugger\scene_debugger.cpp:1790:24: note: 'nodes_ci' declared here
        LocalVector<ObjectID> nodes_ci;
                              ^
scene\debugger\scene_debugger.cpp:1851:84: error: use of undeclared identifier 'selected_3d_nodes'; did you mean 'selected_ci_nodes'?
        if (!changed && nodes_ci.size() == selected_ci_nodes.size() && nodes_3d.size() == selected_3d_nodes.size()) {
                                                                                          ^~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
                                                                                          selected_ci_nodes
scene\debugger/scene_debugger.h:242:24: note: 'selected_ci_nodes' declared here
        LocalVector<ObjectID> selected_ci_nodes;
                              ^
4 errors generated.
```

### Steps to reproduce

1. Clone master https://github.com/godotengine/godot/commit/b377562b52fa8a68a99d5e818d8e08ac8d3fd7da
2. Build with `scons platform=android target=template_debug arch=arm64 disable_3d=yes`
3. Wait for it.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

N/A
